findings.title: Initial encoded sources for one original tree can disagree
findings.impact: Explicit parent adapter accepts arbitrary incompatible initial query/reference rows for duplicate clipped original-tree cache graphs, producing altered contexts despite compatible feature/operator metadata.
findings.recommendation: Require a declared and validated original-encoder-source compatibility policy before use. Compare initial duplicate query/reference encoder rows under justified dtype/device tolerances, or bind them to validated producer output evidence. Do not compare evolved anchor contexts or deduplicate original occurrences.

findings.title: Streamed action omits original computed-decay numerical domain
findings.impact: The unchanged baseline rejects nonfinite or nonpositive lambda*eigenvalue+damping, but the streamed action accepts these cases and can emit finite underflowed or growing states.
findings.recommendation: Retain the baseline finite/strictly-positive computed-decay check per fixed graph hold before exponentiation.

findings.title: Parent update helper accepts a loss disconnected from optimizer parameters
findings.impact: A standalone requires_grad loss leaf passes as a connected loss, yielding no optimizer gradients, unchanged parameters and empty AdamW state while reporting one optimizer step.
findings.recommendation: Validate a gradient connection to the intended optimizer parameter set, and reject a parent objective with no connected optimizer parameters. Preserve legitimate individually unused parameters.

duplicate_encoded_source_semantics.reason_for_rejection: The declared original per-tree encoder source semantic contract is stricter than arbitrary forcing. Identical clipped occurrences must retain compatible initial query/reference encoder outputs. Matching declared feature fingerprints and Cqq/Cqr do not establish this for caller-supplied encoded tensors.
narrow_successor_options: Encode each validated original tree once and reuse its initial Q/R rows across clipped occurrences
Reject incompatible initial duplicate query/reference rows under a disclosed fixed dtype/device numerical policy

decay_guard_semantics.placement: Each fixed graph hold before exponentiation
